title: Ukraine updates: Russia hit with second car bomb attack in two days
summary: A second car bomb in two days exploded in Moscow, targeting an exiled Ukrainian political aide, according to Russian media. Meanwhile, Ukraine and Russia exchanged deadly strikes overnight. DW has…

blocks.text: WATCH: As Russia pounds Ukraine's infrastructure, Kyiv faces winter blackouts

Kyiv residents are bracing for another difficult winter as Russian airstrikes continue to target the Ukrainian capital’s energy infrastructure. Long and unpredictable power and water outages are disrupting daily life, forcing families to rely on batteries, portable power stations and improvised routines.
